text:
Marta: Quick check — launch day social schedule is nearly final. Need confirmation on: X thread cadence, LinkedIn timing, CTA funnel for webinar signups, and inbound lead routing to SDRs. Draft schedule here: https://docs.google.com/launch-schedule. Pulls needed by EOD pls.

Sam: Proposed times — X thread (series): 11:00, 14:00; LinkedIn single post: 12:00. Add UTMs to every CTA: `?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_v1`. Route form -> HubSpot list `webinar-signups` -> assign to SDR queue. If signups >500/hr, overflow to SDR-oncall channel.

Kate: Assets ready: 3 hero images (16:9), 2 short clips (15s), 1 GIF. Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folder/launch-assets. Need copy variants: Variant A (product-first) + Variant B (customer-story). Can we A/B test the X thread opener? Also need alt text and caption for LinkedIn.

Ben: We can handle ~200 leads/hr for initial outreach. Who owns templated cadence? Also need explicit UTM+leadsource field in webhook payload so we can tag leads. If overflow hits, what SLA for handoff?

Jen: I'll own the follow-up templates and SLA. Recommended cadence: 1) immediate confirmation email (template in folder), 2) 24h personalized follow-up, 3) 3-day reminder with CTA to book a demo. Use contact property `webinar_interest` and priority score >= 50 for same-day SDR touches. I'll add templates and HubSpot workflow by noon tomorrow.

AnalyticsBot: Quick note — modeling predicts +5% CTR for X thread posting at 11:00 vs 09:00 given our follower engagement window. Also expect 8-12% conversion to webinar landing page with the hero clip used. Will post detailed deck.

Marta: Awesome, thanks. Two final asks: 1) If you have objections to times/UTMs/cadence, drop them here. 2) Please react :thumbsup: to approve by 4pm — I'll lock schedule at 5pm and push to the scheduler (Buffer/Encore). Also flag any embargoed partners or regional language needs now.

Sam: Confirmed from my side. :thumbsup:

Kate: I'll do the A/B copy and add alt text by 3pm.

Ben: Adding intake checklist for SDRs to the folder now.

Jen: Working on workflows, will ping when done.

Marta: Locking notes — thanks everyone.
